generation_settings.duration_seconds: 2.2 for frequent cues, 3.2 for opening, 4.2 for finale
generation_settings.post_processing: Peak-matched locally after download; no synthesis or replacement content was added.

production_gate: Listen to every cue in context on phone and tablet before Production promotion.

assets.prompt: A real wooden garden gate opens, followed by two distinct footsteps on a stone path. A warm acoustic marimba and nylon-string guitar invitation motif rises over subtle outdoor courtyard ambience. Polished, modern educational adventure cue, welcoming and human. No voice, no synth bleeps, no arcade sounds.

A tactile wooden percussion click followed by a warm two-note acoustic marimba discovery flourish. Natural room tone, human and rewarding, with a gentle resonance that resolves clearly. Modern educational game feedback. No voice, no coin, no jackpot, no arcade bleeps, no synthetic alarm.

assets.role: arrival in a new mission chapter
assets.prompt: Real footsteps arrive on a stone patio, a light fabric banner flutters, then a short warm acoustic marimba and nylon-string guitar flourish marks entry into a new part of the adventure. Upbeat, grounded and natural. No voice, no electronic bleeps, no cartoon swoosh.

Natural microphone-room presence, a soft hand-percussion pulse, then a warm rising acoustic marimba and small bell resonance that confirms a spoken answer. Confident, fresh and human, with a clear beginning and gentle tail. No voice, no phone notification, no synthetic arcade sound.

A friendly real woodblock tap, followed by a quiet downward muted marimba interval and a soft reassuring acoustic tail. It should communicate try once more without punishment, warm and encouraging. No voice, no buzzer, no error alarm, no comedy, no electronic arcade bleeps.

assets.role: clear handoff to the learner before recording
assets.prompt: A calm speaking-turn cue made from one soft wooden click, a brief natural breath of room space, and one warm acoustic bell tone that blooms gently and leaves clear silence for the learner. It means now it is your turn to speak. No voice, no countdown, no phone notification, no electronic beep.

Real family courtyard celebration ambience, gentle handclaps and joyful movement, warm acoustic guitar and marimba flourish resolving brightly, heartfelt polished ending. No speech, no crowd chant, no electronic bleeps.
